submitted.rationale: Highest measured photocurrent: 3.04e-5 A. The V-rich corner (V about 0.6) gave about 80x more photocurrent than the Bi-rich region. XRD suggests the samples there are mixtures: a phase whose peaks line up with monoclinic BiVO4 (Q 1.35, 2.035, 2.15, 2.38 1/A) plus a second phase with a strong peak at Q 1.744. From its composition that second phase may be a Cu vanadate such as CuV2O6, but I did not confirm it against reference patterns. Moving from 54 toward more Bi / less Cu at the same V (to 142) raised photocurrent slightly, from 2.82e-5 to 3.04e-5 A.
